bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge BigBang
bricks.description: Independent initial installer plus separately confirmed BigCrunch removal of every installed Forge package, including God and BigBang. The dry run and confirmed batch use frozen installed non-Forge Registry/BuiltIn version pins; review explains direct manifest entries. External dependents, unsafe local sources and retained-package changes block removal. Unity 6000.6.3f1: both complete prerequisite fixtures passed 145/145 tests. Actual disposable removal of all twelve Forge packages in catalogue 0.58.3 with real Odin 4.0.2.4, Quantum Console 2.6.7, Steamworks.NET 2025.164.1 and copied game assets passed after real self-unload. All 53 retained package identities and 1,102 protected file hashes remained unchanged; only twelve exact Forge-owned settings files were deleted. Baseline follows initial vendor import; unrelated experimental pipeline/AI/tutorial hooks were excluded. Interactive checks remain skipped at user request. Games retaining Forge references, optional unlisted integrations, native Steam and player behavior are not certified. Live consumers update manually.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge God
bricks.description: God manages Forge packages, bootstrap foundations and the Editor-only Commandments service. Shows actual archive size and shared progress in compact/standalone/embedded views: measured percentage with a known total, activity otherwise. API 1.2 exposes an immutable download snapshot retained through validation/outcomes. Preserves consent, four-target boundaries, offline reading and legacy integration guards. Unity 6000.6.3f1: 429 Editor checks passed, zero failed, seven conditional skips; exact Git source/example, real archive/contract validation and normal/narrow native captures verified. Physical input, other skins, high DPI and new player acceptance are not certified. Consumer updates remain manual.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Steam
bricks.description: Optional Windows x64 Mono preparation with passive inspection, reviewed defaults, shared findings, build checks and default-off local native activation. Requires God 0.37.0; other Forge peers remain optional. Exact Steamworks.NET 2025.164.1 profile is provisioned explicitly in the project. Unity 6000.6.3f1: 25 Editor and 4 injected Play Mode checks passed, zero failed or skipped. Actual standalone/embedded normal/narrow UI, Help, blocked Save and Undo reviewed. Current wrapper-present/absent Windows players run unconfigured without native loading; all six selected bricks run. Real native Steam integration, overlay, alternate skin/DPI and physical-device acceptance remain unverified. Customer distribution and Steam Deck remain deferred.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Angels
bricks.description: Optional Editor project tools with independent Renaming/Reorganising, measured progress, current-assets scans and GUID-backed exclusions. Codex supplies semantic Type, Category and Description using local Commandments and primary GDD. Canonical optional numeric versions/varieties now survive semantic changes and organization moves, including padding; Description digits are not suffixes. Occupied destinations receive the first free _1, _2 and onward, protecting originals, metadata, folders and pending plans with stable retries and no nested numbers. GUID metadata and matching prefab roots/child references retained. Valid numbered proposals survive reload; previous Codex naming consent pauses for a fresh review. Requires Commandments 0.58.3 / Setup 1.8.1 or newer. Existing opt-in actual-audio analysis, Windows-secured credentials, bounded coverage, cancellation/drift protections and script/vendor/fixed-identity exclusions retained. Unity 6000.6.3f1: 351 distinct Editor checks passed, zero failed, 2 conditional symlink skips; full suite plus final numeric/reload/consent checks, released 0.9.1 fresh setup and immutable Git update validated. Signed-in synthetic-GDD visual and controlled process regressions passed. Existing normal/narrow UI renders recorded; physical input, alternate skins/high DPI, live audio API and calibrated semantic accuracy remain unverified. Consumer adoption is manual.
